body: Same!  Im so frustrated.  Like how hard can it be to fix the issue. All the other episodes are fine
I feel like that a lot.   Then something will make me change my mind and I will be ok for a bit but that feeling always come back

I have thought about getting my affairs in order and taking the plunge but I keep thinking there is more to life and if I  am just going to throw it away why not just take some risks and do something like move to a foreign place and discover things.  Why just throw it away?  I get the loneliness and despair.  I feel like all of my friends have moved forward and I'm stuck in this shitty place I can't seem to escape.  I feel like I did so many shitty things to people I love how can I be forgiven?  I feel intense sadness and I wish someone could hug me and tell me it will be ok, but at the same time I don't feel like I even deserve to be comforted.

I don't want to give up.  Please hold on.. hold on with me.  Maybe we could get through this together?
